# Hi, I'm Nick. 🖖

Product and Graphic designer based in London, UK. I have 10+ years of experience in design across user experience, user interaction, visual design, prototyping and brand/identity. Passionate about emerging technologies and solving problems with design that improve the relationship between people and the products and environments that we engage in. I’m a big advocate for methodical thinking within design — using research, insights and data to create meaningful impact for customers and brands.

Clients include: Christie's, Channel 4, Zalando, Eurostar, BT Group, BookingGo, Fiat Chrysler Automobiles, Honda, Hargreaves Lansdown, Just Eat, Lawn Tennis Association, National Savings & Investments, Lawn Tennis Association, Virgin, Visa.

If there's a business problem or project you need help with, Get in touch.
